source_refs.note: PDF 220 (book p. 218): unit 7 introduction and the 7.1 definition of rectilinear motion

blocks.text: Assalam o alaikum bachon! Aaj se hum ek naya unit shuru kar rahe hain: Kinematics of Motion in a Straight Line. Ab tak aap ne calculus mein derivative aur integral seekhe hain, magar aksar yeh sawal zehan mein aata hai ke "yeh sab asal zindagi mein kahan kaam aata hai?" Is unit mein iska seedha jawab milega. Gaari ka chalna, gend ka upar phenkna, kisi cheez ka girna: in sab ko hum derivative aur integral se samjhenge.

Kitab ka introduction yeh kehta hai: Kinematics mechanics ki woh shaakh (branch) hai jo cheezon ki motion (harkat) ko bayan karti hai, magar motion ki wajah (cause) par baat nahin karti. Is unit mein hum dekhenge ke cheezein seedhi line (straight line) mein kaise chalti hain, aur is ke liye teen aham physical quantities parhenge: displacement, velocity aur acceleration. Displacement-time aur velocity-time graphs bana kar aur un ko parh kar hum motion ko tasweer ki shakal mein samjhenge. Unit mein rate of change (tabdeeli ki raftaar) ka istemal bhi aata hai, yani yeh dekhna ke waqt ke saath displacement, velocity aur acceleration kaise badalte hain. Time ke lehaaz se differentiation aur integration kar ke hum motion ke aasaan sawal hal karenge. Jahan acceleration constant (ek jaisa) ho, wahan kinematic formulae laga kar na-maloom quantities nikaalenge. Aakhir mein yeh sab asal zindagi par lagayenge: gaariyon ki motion, free fall (azad girna), vertical projectile motion (seedha upar phenki hui cheez), relative motion, aur animation mein asal jaisi harkat banana.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Kinematics sirf teen sawalon ka jawab deti hai: cheez kahan hai? kitni tezi se chal rahi hai? aur kya us ki raftaar barh rahi hai ya ghat rahi hai? "Kyun chal rahi hai" yeh sawal kinematics ka nahin; woh forces ka kaam hai jo aap Physics mein parhte hain. Is liye yahan sirf motion ko bayan karna hai, aur is ke auzaar (tools) wohi hain jo aap ke paas pehle se hain:
1. Differentiation rate of change deta hai. Displacement ka rate of change velocity hai, aur velocity ka rate of change acceleration hai.
2. Integration ulti taraf le jata hai: acceleration se velocity, aur velocity se displacement.
3. Graph yehi kahani tasweer mein dikhata hai: graph ka slope (dhalaan) rate of change hota hai, aur velocity-time graph ke neeche ka area displacement hota hai.
Unit ka naqsha bhi dekh lijiye: 7.1.1 aur 7.1.2 mein scalar aur vector ka farq, 7.1.3 mein average aur instantaneous velocity aur acceleration, 7.1.4 aur 7.1.5 mein displacement-time aur velocity-time graphs, 7.1.6 mein constant acceleration wali equations, aur 7.1.7 mein gravity ke neeche upar ya neeche chalne wali cheezein. Har sabaq agle sabaq ki buniyaad hai, is liye koi sabaq chhorna nahin.
Ab asal definition. Kitab kehti hai: kisi particle ki seedhi line ke saath motion ko rectilinear motion kehte hain.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Is definition ke do lafz ghor se samajhiye.
Particle: aisi cheez jis ka size (jasaamat) hum nazar-andaaz kar dete hain aur use sirf ek point maan lete hain. Lambi sarak par chalti gaari, ya chhat se girta hua pathar, particle maana ja sakta hai, kyun ke humein sirf yeh jaanna hai ke woh line par kahan hai; us ki lambai chaurai se is sawal mein koi farq nahin parta.
Straight line: particle sirf ek hi line par aage ya peeche chal sakta hai. Misaalen: seedhi sarak par gaari, upar neeche jaati lift, ya seedha upar phenki hui gend.
Ab is motion ko numbers mein kaise likhein? Line par ek point O fix kar lete hain (yeh origin hai), aur line ki ek taraf ko positive maan lete hain. Phir waqt \(t\) par particle ki position ek hi number \(x(t)\) se bata di jati hai, bilkul number line ke point ki tarah: \(x = 5\) ka matlab O se positive taraf 5 units, aur \(x = -3\) ka matlab O se negative taraf 3 units.
Roz ki misaal: aap ka ghar origin hai, school ki taraf positive. Agar aap ghar se 2 km school ki taraf hain to \(x = 2\); agar ulti taraf bazaar mein 1 km par hain to \(x = -1\). Bas itni si baat hai!

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
(Yeh hamari misaal hai, kitab ki nahin.) Ek seedhi sarak par bus stop ko origin O maan lijiye aur shehar ki taraf ko positive. Subah 8 baje ek rickshaw O se 2 km shehar ki taraf hai, 8:10 par 5 km par, aur 8:30 par wapas mur kar 1 km par.
To \(x\) ki values yeh hain: \(x = 2\), phir \(x = 5\), phir \(x = 1\) (km mein). Teeno positive hain kyun ke rickshaw har waqt O ke shehar wali taraf hai. Lekin dhyan dein: 5 se 1 par aana yeh batata hai ke rickshaw ulti taraf chala. Yaani sirf sign se nahin, \(x\) ke barhne ya ghatne se bhi pata chalta hai ke particle kis taraf ja raha hai. Yehi baat aage velocity ke sign mein nazar aayegi: \(x\) barh raha ho to velocity positive, ghat raha ho to negative.
Agar rickshaw O se guzar kar doosri taraf 2 km chala jaye, to \(x = -2\) likhenge. Minus ka matlab "kam" nahin, balke "O ki doosri taraf" hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Is unit ke liye kya kya pehle se aana chahiye? Teen cheezein: (1) derivative nikaalna, khaas taur par power rule, jaise \(\frac{d}{dt}(t^{3}) = 3t^{2}\); (2) aasaan integrals, jaise \(\int t\,dt = \frac{t^{2}}{2} + c\); (3) graph ka slope, yani rise ko run se divide karna. Agar in mein se koi cheez kamzor hai to pehle us ko dohra lijiye, phir yeh unit bohat aasaan lagega. Darne ki koi baat nahin: is unit ka zyada tar hisaab chhota aur seedha hai; asal kaam yeh samajhna hai ke har number ka matlab kya hai.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
Neeche se kaun si motion rectilinear hai? (a) seedhi patri par chalti train, (b) gol chakkar (roundabout) par ghoomti gaari, (c) chhat se seedha neeche girti gend.
Jawab: (a) aur (c) rectilinear hain, kyun ke dono ek seedhi line par hain. (b) rectilinear nahin, kyun ke gaari ka raasta gol (circle) hai, seedhi line nahin.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Kinematics motion ko bayan karti hai (position, velocity, acceleration); motion ki wajah nahin poochti.
2. Rectilinear motion = particle ki seedhi line ke saath motion.
3. Seedhi line par position ek signed number \(x(t)\) hai jo fixed origin O se naapa jata hai; sign batata hai ke particle O ki kis taraf hai.
4. Is unit ka asal auzaar calculus hai: rate of change ke liye differentiate karein, wapas aane ke liye integrate karein.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Yeh samajhna ke "rectilinear" ka matlab "ek jaisi speed" hai. Nahin! Is ka matlab sirf "seedhi line ke saath" hai. Particle us line par tez ho sakta hai, aahista ho sakta hai, ruk sakta hai, ya wapas mur sakta hai.
2. Koi bhi number likhne se pehle origin aur positive direction fix na karna. In ke baghair \(x = -3\) jaisi value ka koi matlab hi nahin banta.
